name: atm-dashboard
description: Source for the Agentic Task Manager dashboard. Builds to a single self-contained HTML file.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:page && vite build -c vite.compmd.config.ts
scripts.build:page: pnpm run generate && vite build && node build/finish-page.ts
scripts.size: pnpm run generate && ATM_SIZE_REPORT=1 vite build
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build && cargo build --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml && playwright test --grep-invert visual
scripts.check: pnpm run generate && node scripts/check-versions.mjs && svelte-check --fail-on-warnings && eslint . && prettier --config .prettierrc --check . ../tests/scripts
scripts.verify: pnpm run check && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test:e2e && pnpm run test:e2e:visual
scripts.build:atm-linux: pnpm run build && docker run --rm -v "$(cd .. && pwd)":/repo -v atm-linux-cargo-registry:/usr/local/cargo/registry -w /repo -e RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=1.99.0 rust:1.99.0-bookworm@sha256:114c7a4425406451c2866b6aafe69fe29b1b298832db1277d411ac73c82d04d6 cargo build --locked -p atm-cli --target-dir target/linux
